purpose: Representative Windows guardrail manifest used to detect regressions from macOS-focused changes.
rationale: Phase 14 macOS optimizations must not regress Windows benchmark behavior. This guardrail slice covers the same tier spectrum as the macOS replay slice but focuses on cases that exercise Windows-sensitive paths: Docker validation fallback, path normalization, and platform-specific skip behavior. The slice is intentionally smaller than the macOS replay slice to keep guardrail checks fast.
